characters.name: Ken Kaneki
characters.role: Tragic Ghoul Hybrid & Leader of Goat
characters.quote: I'm not the protagonist of a novel. I'm just a college student who likes to read... but if you were to write a story with me in the lead role, it would certainly be... a tragedy.
characters.biography: Formerly a timid Japanese literature student at Kamii University, Kaneki's fate was forever altered following a predatory encounter with Rize Kamishiro. Transplanted with her kakuhou organs, he became the world's first synthetic half-ghoul. Enduring torturous psychological fragmentation at the hands of Yamori, Kaneki embraced his predatory instincts to protect those he loves, evolving from an insecure youth into the legendary One-Eyed King.

characters.name: Tanjiro Kamado
characters.quote: No matter how many people you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living. No matter how devastating the blows may be.
characters.biography: Following the horrific slaughter of his family and the turning of his sister Nezuko into a demon, Tanjiro swore an oath to eradicate Muzan Kibutsuji. Combining profound empathy with unmatched perseverance, he mastered both Water Breathing and his family's ancient Hinokami Kagura, awakening the legendary Demon Slayer Mark.

characters.name: Satoru Gojo
characters.quote: Don't worry, I'm the strongest.
characters.biography: The undisputed pinnacle of the modern sorcery world. Born with both the Limitless technique and the legendary Six Eyes—a biological convergence not seen in four centuries—Gojo bends spatial infinity at will. His nonchalant demeanor conceals a strategic mind committed to nurturing a generation capable of overthrowing conservative sorcery aristocracy.

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.quote: If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win. Fight! Fight!
characters.biography: Driven by an obsessive yearning for absolute freedom, Eren witnessed the breach of Wall Maria as a child. Discovering he inherited the Attack and Founding Titans, his quest shifted from destroying mindless monsters to crushing the global coalition of Marley via the apocalyptic Rumbling.

characters.name: Major Motoko Kusanagi
characters.quote: There are many things that make up the human body and mind... a face, a voice, memories. All of that goes into making me, me.
characters.biography: Possessing a full-body cybernetic prosthetic since childhood, the Major is one of the world's most formidable tactical commanders and net-divers. Leading Section 9 against cyber-terrorism and sentient rogue networks, she constantly questions the boundary between mechanical shell and human ghost.

characters.name: V (Valerie / Vincent)
characters.quote: A thing of beauty will never fade away. Here's to making a splash in Night City.
characters.biography: An ambitious solo mercenary trying to climb the treacherous underworld of Night City. After a heist at Konpeki Plaza goes disastrously wrong, V is infected with the biochip carrying rockstar-terrorist Johnny Silverhand. Facing rapid neurological degradation, V shoots their way through megacorps, fixers, and rogue military enclaves.

characters.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
characters.quote: I am Malenia, Blade of Miquella. And I have never known defeat.
characters.biography: Cursed from birth with Scarlet Rot, Malenia traded limbs for prosthetic unalloyed gold to shield her twin brother Miquella. Renowned for her lightning-fast Waterfowl Dance and peerless swordsmanship, she fought General Radahn to a devastating standstill in Caelid.

characters.name: Geralt of Rivia
characters.quote: Evil is Evil. Lesser, greater, middling... Makes no difference. If I'm to choose between one evil and another, I'd rather not choose at all.
characters.biography: Subjected to the lethal Trial of the Grasses at the Witcher fortress of Kaer Morhen, Geralt gained inhuman reflexes, cat-like vision, and resistance to disease. Roaming the war-torn Continent, he protects humanity from horrors while navigating murky royal conspiracies.

characters.name: Cloud Strife
characters.quote: No one lives in the slums because they want to. It's like this train. It can't go anywhere except where its rails take it.
characters.biography: Wielding the iconic oversized Buster Sword, Cloud arrived in Midgar believing himself to be an elite SOLDIER veteran. Unraveling false memories implanted by Jenova cells and Hojo's horrific experiments, he leads AVALANCHE to stop Sephiroth from obliterating the Planet.

characters.name: Kratos
characters.alias: Ghost of Sparta / God of War
characters.quote: Do not be sorry. Be better.
characters.biography: Having slaughtered the Olympus pantheon in an ocean of righteous vengeance, Kratos sought exile in the Norse realms. Now living with his son Atreus, he strives to curb his volcanic rage and teach his boy how to be a god without losing his soul.

characters.name: Paul Atreides
characters.role: Duke of House Atreides & Fremen Messiah
characters.quote: My road leads into the desert. I can see the holy war spreading across the universe like an unquenchable fire.
characters.biography: Born the son of Duke Leto Atreides and the Bene Gesserit Lady Jessica, Paul was trained from infancy in Prana-Bindu neuromuscular control and Mentat logic. When his house was betrayed by the Harkonnens on desert planet Arrakis, he rallied the Fremen, took the Water of Life, and unlocked terrifying omnipresent prescience.

characters.name: Neo (Thomas Anderson)
characters.quote: I know what you're trying to do. I'm going to hang up this phone, and then I'm going to show these people what you don't want them to see.
characters.biography: A disillusioned software hacker unplugged by Morpheus and Trinity, Neo discovered that human civilization is imprisoned in a simulation by sentient machines. Accepting his destiny as 'The One', he rewrites simulated physics, dodges bullets, and halts machine armies.

characters.name: Rick Deckard
characters.quote: I was quit. I was home, reading a book, minding my own business.
characters.biography: Stalking rain-slicked, neon-drenched Los Angeles in 2019, Deckard's assignment was simple: administer Voight-Kampff tests and 'retire' rogue Nexus-6 replicants. Through his relationship with Rachael and brutal showdown with Roy Batty, Deckard's own humanity is deeply examined.

characters.name: Ellen Ripley
characters.quote: Get away from her, you bitch!
characters.biography: The sole survivor of the commercial starfreighter USCSS Nostromo after it brought an extraterrestrial apex predator on board. Refusing to yield to Weyland-Yutani corporate cynicism, Ripley fought the Queen Xenomorph in a cargo powerloader.

characters.name: Darth Vader
characters.quote: I find your lack of faith disturbing.
characters.biography: Once the prophesied 'Chosen One' who was destined to bring balance to the Force, Anakin succumbed to Emperor Palpatine's manipulation to save Padmé. Encased in black life-support armor following his duel on Mustafar, Vader ruled the galaxy with an iron fist.

characters.name: Jinx (Powder)
characters.quote: I'm not crazy... well, mostly. But who isn't down here?
characters.biography: Orphaned in the undercity of Zaun and traumatized after accidentally killing her adoptive family with a homemade Hextech bomb, Powder was nurtured by kingpin Silco into the chaotic weapon of terror named Jinx. Armed with Fishbones, Pow-Pow, and Shimmer-infused veins, she declares war on Piltover.

characters.name: Eleven (Jane Hopper)
characters.quote: Friends don't lie.
characters.biography: Raised in isolation within Hawkins National Laboratory by Dr. Martin Brenner, Eleven developed extraordinary psychic powers that accidentally ruptured a rift into the dark alternate dimension known as the Upside Down.

characters.name: Din Djarin
characters.role: Bounty Hunter & Clan of Two Patriarch
characters.quote: This is the Way.
characters.biography: A devout member of the Children of the Watch, Din Djarin never removes his helmet in the presence of living beings. Hired by an Imperial remnant to recover a mysterious 50-year-old infant named Grogu, Din broke the Bounty Guild code to rescue the child.

characters.name: Homelander (John)
characters.quote: I'm the Homelander. And I can do whatever the f**k I want.
characters.biography: Lab-grown by Vought American and subjected to clinical childhood sensory deprivation, Homelander is the world's most powerful superhero. Cloaked behind American flags and marketing endorsements, he is a sociopathic narcissist who views regular humanity as insects.

characters.name: Vi (Violet)
characters.quote: We've all got to find our own way.
characters.biography: Fierce, unyielding, and fiercely protective of her younger sister Powder, Vi spent years rotting in Stillwater Prison after being framed. Partnering with Caitlyn Kiramman, she dons heavy Atlas Gauntlets to stop the spread of Shimmer and confront the monster her sister has become.

characters.name: Haerin (Kang Hae-rin)
characters.quote: Music connects across frequencies that words can never define.
characters.biography: Known worldwide for her hypnotic feline gaze and effortless stage charisma, Haerin is a creative catalyst in NewJeans. Championing the group's Y2K nostalgia and liquid hip-hop rhythms, she bridges high fashion global ambassadorships with dreamcore aesthetics.

characters.name: Jungkook (Jeon Jung-kook)
characters.quote: Effort makes you. You will regret someday if you don't do your best now.
characters.biography: Joining Big Hit Entertainment as a teenager, Jungkook earned the title 'Golden Maknae' for his flawless proficiency in vocals, rap, breakdancing, and visual arts. His solo debut broke global Spotify records, solidifying his role as one of the 21st century's premier pop royalty.

characters.name: Jennie (Jennie Kim)
characters.quote: Don't ask how I did it. Just watch what I do next.
characters.biography: Trained across New Zealand and Seoul, Jennie brings razor-sharp rap delivery and sultry RnB cadences. Headlining festivals like Coachella, she blends fierce high-fashion runway dominance with infectious pop hits.

characters.name: Felix (Lee Felix)
characters.quote: Stay who you are. The world needs your unique light.
characters.biography: Hailing from Sydney, Australia, Felix shocked the world with his impossibly deep vocal register contrasting with his ethereal freckled visuals. As the lead dancer of Stray Kids, his powerful movements power the self-producing group's signature 'Maniac' sound.

characters.name: Karina (Yoo Ji-min)
characters.quote: We break beyond the boundary of virtual and reality.
characters.biography: Leading SM Entertainment's metaverse concept group aespa, Karina operates alongside her digital counterpart ae-KARINA in the KWANGYA narrative universe. Her computer-generated facial proportions and sharp dance isolations set the bar for 4th gen K-Pop.

characters.name: Miles Morales
characters.quote: Everyone keeps telling me how my story is supposed to go. Nah. Imma do my own thing.
characters.biography: Bitten by an alchemically enhanced Oz-formula arachnid from Earth-42, Brooklyn teen Miles Morales stepped into the mantle of Spider-Man following Peter Parker's tragic death. Possessing unique bio-electric Venom blasts and camouflage invisibility, he boldly rejected the dogmatic Spider-Society canon.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne
characters.quote: I am vengeance. I am the night. I am Batman!
characters.biography: After witnessing his parents murdered in Crime Alley, young Bruce Wayne forged his mind and body into an instrument of absolute justice. Master of over 127 martial arts and possessing peerless forensic deduction, Batman battles cosmic gods using nothing but human intellect and prep-time.

characters.name: Logan
characters.quote: I'm the best there is at what I do, but what I do best isn't very nice.
characters.biography: Born in 19th-century Canada with a mutant healing factor and bone claws, James Howlett was forcibly abducted by the Weapon X program, who bonded indestructible Adamantium to his skeleton. Living through centuries of warfare, Wolverine is the relentless berserker heart of the X-Men.

characters.name: Al Simmons
characters.quote: You sent me to hell. Now I'm bringing hell to you.
characters.biography: A betrayed CIA black-ops assassin who made a bargain with the demon lord Malebolgia to see his wife Wanda once more. Reborn with symbiotic necroplasmic costume K7-Leetha and chains, Spawn slaughtered the armies of both Heaven and Hell.

characters.name: Wanda Maximoff
characters.quote: No more mutants.
characters.biography: A Nexus Being endowed with innate Chaos Magic capable of altering probability and reality itself. From her mutant beginnings in Magneto's Brotherhood to reshaping the entire timeline with three whispered words, Wanda stands among the most fearsome figures in all of comic history.

characters.name: Denji
characters.quote: If there's a hell out there, I've already been through it. Now give me toast with jam!
characters.biography: Living in sub-human poverty to repay yakuza loan sharks, Denji bonded with Pochita, the Chainsaw Devil. After being murdered and resurrecting with a pull-cord in his chest, Denji sprouts whirring chainsaws from his head and limbs, eviscerating primeval devils for the simplest human comforts.

characters.name: Guts
characters.quote: Even if we painstakingly piece together something lost, it doesn't mean things will ever go back to how they were.
characters.biography: Born from a corpse suspended from a hanging tree, Guts knows only war and steel. Leading the Band of the Hawk's vanguard under Griffith, he survived the demonic Eclipse through superhuman grit. Branded with the Mark of Sacrifice, he hunts Apostles with the 400-pound Dragonslayer slab.

characters.name: Thorfinn Karlsefni
characters.alias: Son of Thors / The True Warrior
characters.quote: I have no enemies. No one in this world is my enemy.
characters.biography: Consumed by venomous vengeance against Askeladd for his father's murder, Thorfinn spent his teenage years slaughtering on Anglo-Saxon battlefields. Breaking free from slavery, he renounces violence and embarks on an odyssey to found a peaceful land across the western sea.

characters.name: Dr. Kenzo Tenma
characters.quote: All human lives are equal. No one has the right to take another's life.
characters.biography: A brilliant Japanese neurosurgeon living in West Germany whose career was skyrocketing. Choosing his conscience over hospital politics, Tenma saved the life of a dying boy named Johan Liebert—unwittingly unleashing a demonic sociopath upon the world.

characters.name: Shinichi Izumi
characters.quote: We are fragile creatures. But that's why we treasure the things we have.
characters.biography: When extraterrestrial spores fell on Earth, one attempted to burrow into Shinichi's brain, but was quarantined in his right hand. Living in uneasy symbiosis with the rational parasite 'Migi', Shinichi becomes caught in a silent war between human society and shapeshifting hunters.
